stored_text.note: official.html is the regeringen.se page for SOU 2025:101 with the Government's Swedish abstract. document-1.pdf is the full report (998 pages, text layer present), with a Swedish summary (Sammanfattning, from page 27) and an English summary (Summary, from page 39). secondary.html is the consultation (remiss) page.

english_version.publisher: Government Offices of Sweden (Regeringskansliet), in the SOU itself

evidence.quote: in which the Swedish Post and Telecom Authority (PTS) will be the market surveillance authority with primary responsibility for the AI Act.

english_version.note: Only the summary is in English (report pages 39-50); the report itself, its title and the proposed statutes are in Swedish. The English summary gives no English title for the report. No web search was run.

title.why: original_title matches the stored title. 'Adaptations to the AI Regulation' is a literal and correct rendering of 'Anpassningar till AI-förordningen'. The report's subtitle 'Säker användning, effektiv kontroll och stöd för innovation' (Safe use, effective control and support for innovation) is not in the record, which is normal for an SOU citation. The SOU's English summary calls the EU instrument 'the AI Act', not 'the AI Regulation'.

summary_claims.claim: Government inquiry proposing a new Swedish law and ordinance to supplement the EU AI Act.
summary_claims.original_quote: Utredningen föreslår att de svenska bestämmelser som behöver komplettera AI-förordningen huvudsakligen ska samlas i en ny lag och en ny förordning.
summary_claims.literal_translation: The inquiry proposes that the Swedish provisions needed to supplement the AI Regulation should mainly be gathered in a new act and a new ordinance.

summary_claims.claim: It proposes eleven market surveillance authorities and two notifying authorities, with the Post and Telecom Authority (PTS) holding main responsibility.
summary_claims.original_quote: som består av elva marknadskontrollmyndigheter och två anmälande myndigheter. Vidare föreslår utredningen att Post- och telestyrelsen ska få ett huvudsakligt ansvar för marknadskontroll enligt AI-förordningen.
summary_claims.literal_translation: [a system for market monitoring, market surveillance, governance and enforcement] consisting of eleven market surveillance authorities and two notifying authorities. The inquiry further proposes that the Post and Telecom Authority should have main responsibility for market surveillance under the AI Regulation.

summary_claims.claim: It also covers sanctions ... and an AI regulatory sandbox run by PTS.
summary_claims.original_quote: Utredningen föreslår vidare bestämmelser om sanktioner och ingripanden samt bestämmelser om vissa innovationsfrämjande åtgärder, bland annat om regulatoriska sandlådor för AI. Post- och telestyrelsen föreslås inrätta en sådan regulatorisk sandlåda.
summary_claims.literal_translation: The inquiry further proposes provisions on sanctions and interventions and provisions on certain innovation-promoting measures, including AI regulatory sandboxes. The Post and Telecom Authority is proposed to set up such a regulatory sandbox.

key_terms.register_rendering: the AI Regulation (title); the EU AI Act (summary)
key_terms.note: Literal rendering in the title, correct; the SOU's own English summary says 'the AI Act' throughout. The summary already uses 'EU AI Act'.
Swedish separates 'marknadsövervakning' (rendered 'market monitoring' in the English summary) from 'marknadskontroll' ('market surveillance'); the register uses the right one.
The English summary names them: Swedac and the Medical Products Agency.

note: 'confidentiality rules' in the summary is supported by the report (Swedish summary: provisions on 'sekretess' and 'tystnadsplikt'; English summary: 'secrecy and professional confidentiality'). The English summary is the only English text; quoting it in the record would let readers see the issuer's own terms.
